The post-build index pass (dev/docs/pagefind_index.py) writes the chunked, per-language Pagefind index into _build/html/pagefind/ after Sphinx runs. This page loads the Pagefind UI bundle from that directory and renders the default search box; the Ctrl-K command palette's full-text tier hands off here (that palette wiring is a separate step, not this template). Pagefind's own ranking and per-language stemming (es/ca/hu/en) serve the full-text results; the injected concept / casilla / CLI custom records ride the same index and surface here too once the custom-record injection lands. The ?q= contract: callers hand off to this page with the reader's query in the `q` parameter (the palette's full-text row emits %20-encoded spaces, the casilla records emit +-encoded ones). URLSearchParams decodes both forms; decodeURIComponent does NOT decode `+` and must not be used here. The query seeds the search so results render on load with the input left populated for refinement. The contract is surface-independent: it survives whatever renders the results (the current PagefindUI drop, or a future palette-hosted surface per ADR D5).
